name: createResponsibility
shortDescription: Creates a new responsibility, assigning it to a Stump participant within a specific category and Quadrant context.
description:
Overview

Creates a new Responsibility record, associating it with a User (Stump), a Category, a Quadrant, and a Molecule.

Intended use

Called by Lead Points or Stumps from the Responsibility and Deliverable Management UI to define new tasks. Parameters include name, description, dueDate, categoryId, quadrantId, moleculeId, and assignedStumpId (or ctx.user_id if Stump is calling).

Logic

  1. Determine assignedStumpId: if ctx.role is 'stump', use ctx.user_id; otherwise, use params.assignedStumpId and validate that params.assignedStumpId corresponds to an existing User with the stump app role. If not found or not a Stump, return an error.
  2. Validate that params.categoryId exists by querying the Category entity using ctx.data.get. If not found, return an error.
  3. Validate that params.quadrantId exists by querying the Quadrant entity using ctx.data.get. If not found, return an error.
  4. Validate that params.moleculeId exists by querying the Molecule entity using ctx.data.get. If not found, return an error.
  5. Create a new Responsibility record using ctx.data.create with name, description, dueDate, categoryId, quadrantId, moleculeId, idOfUser (the assignedStumpId), and assignedByUserId (from ctx.user_id).
  6. Audit-log the responsibility creation using ctx.audit.log, including the responsibility name and assigned stump.
  7. Return the created Responsibility record.

Entities

  • Responsibility
  • User
  • Category
  • Quadrant
  • Molecule
